objective: Preallocate DDL table rewrite data keys from table and row-id lengths.

tasks.title: Preallocate DDL table rewrite data keys
tasks.result: ALTER TABLE primary-key row rewrites now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for new data keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>:<row_id> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in ALTER TABLE ADD PRIMARY KEY row rewrite key construction.
Generated key bytes, duplicate storage-key checks, old-row deletion, new-row writes, row-cache invalidation, index rewrites, and SQL results are unchanged.
